lcc_original: 亞當活在世上的日子共有九百三十年，然後死。
notes: 在世上 ('in the world') is LCC's contextual expansion of חַי with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
的 maps to implicit אֲשֶׁר {<WAH0834>}; LCC uses structural relative particle 的 where Hebrew uses explicit relative pronoun — braces dropped per Rule 3 since 的 is an explicit word
日子 provides explicit rendering of implicit יְמֵי {<WH03117>} — braces dropped per Rule 3
有 in 共有 provides explicit rendering of implicit וַיִּהְיוּ {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} — braces dropped per Rule 3; 共 carries H03605, 有 carries H01961 with morphology
Single 年 covers two Hebrew שָׁנָה occurrences (H08141 appears twice in UNV: once after 百, once after 歲); both tags attached to the single 年 in LCC
